# demo-app — deliberately insecure sample

Not a real application. Every setting here is wrong on purpose, so that a scan of
this directory produces findings across the whole severity and confidence range.

It exists for two jobs:

- checking how findings render in GitHub code scanning, without a real
  third-party project's name appearing in anyone's Security tab
- exercising every reporter against a realistic mixture rather than a single rule

Nothing here should be copied into a real application.
